attacks.name: Swinging Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Impact Webbing
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: If the target character is Size 2 or less, before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Push it Away |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Web-Head Wallop
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Catch!|: After this attack is resolved, you may choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 2 or less and within |!range| 3 of this character and destroy it. The target character suffers a collision as if the terrain feature had collided with it.

superPowers.name: Web-Slinger
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Proportionate Strength of a Spider
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character of Size 3 or less and within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to two of its defense or dodge dice.
